description: This file defines dependency injection providers for network-related components in an Android application, including JSON serialization, demo asset management, HTTP client configuration, and image loader setup using Coil.

methods.name: providesNetworkJson
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of kotlinx.serialization.json.Json configured to ignore unknown keys during deserialization.

methods.name: providesDemoAssetManager
methods.description: Provides a singleton DemoAssetManager initialized with application assets.

methods.name: okHttpCallFactory
methods.description: Provides a singleton OkHttp Call.Factory, wrapped with a tracing span and configured with logging interceptor for debug builds.

methods.name: imageLoader
methods.description: Provides a singleton Coil ImageLoader configured with OkHttp call factory, SVG support, caching preferences, and optional debug logging.
